name: Giratina VSTAR Advanced Deck Building Gift Box

releases.name: Giratina VSTAR Advanced Deck Building Gift Box

description.text: The Giratina VSTAR Advanced Deck Building Gift Box (骑拉帝纳VSTAR卡组构筑进阶礼盒) came out on 21 December 2024 as a way into the Lost Zone decks many players had tried since Shadow of the Blue Sea. It held Giratina V in new artwork, Sableye, Cramorant and two Comfey; 25 Trainer cards for the deck, among them Colress's Experiment, Lost Vacuum, Mirage Gate and Lost City; and ten of each of the eight basic Energy. Giratina VSTAR itself is not in the box. With the cards came a metal VSTAR marker, a Giratina damage-counter box, coin die and card box, a third Radiant Energy theme pack and six 25-card Shadow of the Blue Sea Banish packs. Its 20 kinds of card are numbered out of 20.
